title: Lagrangian Floer theory on Woodward's multiplicity-free $U(2)$-manifolds
summary: In this paper, we study a family of symplectic manifolds introduced by Woodward. These manifolds belong to the broader class of \emph{multiplicity-free} Hamiltonian $G$-manifolds, a generalization of toric manifolds for non-abelian Hamiltonian group actions. Prominent examples of multiplicity-free spaces include coadjoint orbits of $U(n)$ and $SO(n)$ equipped with multiplicity-free $U(n-1)$- and $SO(n-1)$-actions, respectively.
